sendmux-skills-qubrics-agent-email-inbox.description: Use when an AI agent needs read-only triage of an existing Qubrics inbox or unsent reply text from its messages. Trigger for bounded inbox reviews, unread invoice or support searches, and draft-only replies, including agent inbox requests without the Qubrics name. Mailbox mutations and sending are outside this workflow.
sendmux-skills-qubrics-agent-email-inbox.author: qubrics

sendmux-skills-qubrics-attachments.description: Use Qubrics attachment workflows without wasting model context on base64. Use when uploading, downloading, reading, forwarding, or sending email attachments through Qubrics MCP, CLI, SDKs, or direct HTTP, especially when choosing file_path vs presigned upload URL vs inline base64, reading inbound attachments with mailbox_read_attachment, fetching short-lived download_url links, or attaching local files to outbound mail.
sendmux-skills-qubrics-attachments.author: qubrics

sendmux-skills-qubrics-cli.author: qubrics

Do NOT use for a user who already knows their setup and just wants a specific low-level command, code snippet, or API payload (e.g., "write the JSON for an attachment", "install the CLI", "create a mailbox key from…
sendmux-skills-qubrics-email-for-agents.author: qubrics

sendmux-skills-qubrics-email-for-ai-agen.description: Use when an AI agent needs to send one outbound email through Qubrics with human approval, including a status notification or delegated agent send. Use only for a single-message workflow; bulk and batch sends are outside its scope.

sendmux-skills-qubrics-getting-started.author: qubrics

sendmux-skills-qubrics-mailbox-agent.description: Operate inside an already-existing Qubrics mailbox on behalf of an AI agent: read, search, count, sync, triage, file, delete, thread, save or edit a reply draft, or send a message using an API key, scoped agent token, or authorised OAuth profile. Trigger when the user wants an agent to inspect an inbox, find or mark messages, resume a prior sync state, prepare a human-editable draft, or send from that mailbox's identity. Do NOT use this for creating, provisioning, or administering mailboxes, domains, or API keys themselves — that setup and admin work belongs to qubrics-management, not this…
sendmux-skills-qubrics-mailbox-agent.author: qubrics

sendmux-skills-qubrics-management.description: Use this skill for Qubrics account/team administration with a root API key or Management-scoped OAuth connection. This is the go-to skill for domain lifecycle work — create a sending domain, fetch its DNS/zone-file records, verify DNS/MX — even if asked as a single quick step. Also use it for provisioning, suspending, or deleting mailboxes and mailbox API keys; configuring sending accounts/providers; creating, testing, or rotating webhooks; checking billing, spend, or balance; and pulling delivery, incoming, or metrics logs for reporting or admin purposes. Not for initial credential, API-key, OAuth, or profile setup—use qubrics-getting-started; not for reading, searching, syncing, or triaging an inbox—use qubrics-mailbox-agent.
